spec.hypothesis: Separate conditional team learning from D; test one short-spell loss weighting ablation
spec.training: Existing pooled 13 external training matches, same 4-Hz sampled graded rows as baseline, then filter H/A
spec.augmentation: Unchanged clean + Markov ball gap copies, team swap for both; seed 2026 + match index within source
spec.weighting: live_only: uniform within provider; live_spell_weighted: clip(sqrt(5 / training spell seconds), .25, 4), then unit mass per provider
spec.controls: Identical packaged pooled GRU/HGB P(D), 50/50; unchanged physical features, team-swap inference, Viterbi cost 3
spec.conditions: Clean main view; independently seeded existing Markov ball mask supplementary; unchanged player-only D in both
spec.selection: Equal-provider mean official spell F1 on five whole development matches; macro F1 exact-tie break; no baseline promotion
spec.scope: Pooled training with whole-match development separation; no provider holdout, no fresh confirmation
spec.seed_scope: One fixed HGB seed; no seed-robustness claim or adaptive search
